const arabicEls = () => { const out = new Set(); const w = document.createTreeWalker(document.body, NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT); let n; while ((n = w.nextNode())) { if (/[\u0600-\u06FF]/.test(n.textContent) && !n.parentElement.closest('script, style')) out.add(n.parentElement); } return [...out]; }; const els = arabicEls(); return els.length >= 2 && els.every((el) => getComputedStyle(el).direction === 'rtl' || el.matches(':dir(rtl)'));
